query: 给每个订单按金额排名

query: 计算每个客户的累计消费金额

business_scenario: 客户生命周期价值(LTV)分析

query: 查询每个商品的销售额及其在所有商品中的排名
sql: WITH product_sales AS (SELECT ProductID, SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) as total_sales FROM "Order Details" GROUP BY ProductID) SELECT ProductID, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as sales_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as dense_rank FROM product_sales;

query: 计算每个月的销售额及环比增长率
sql: WITH monthly_sales AS (SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.OrderDate) as month, SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice) as sales FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" oi ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID GROUP BY month) SELECT month, sales, LAG(sales) OVER (ORDER BY month) as prev_month_sales, ROUND((sales - LAG(sales) OVER (ORDER BY month)) * 100.0 / LAG(sales) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) as growth_rate FROM monthly_sales;

query: 查询每个客户的第一笔订单和最后一笔订单的时间差
sql: WITH customer_order_dates AS (SELECT CustomerID, OrderDate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate) as first_order, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate DESC) as last_order FROM Orders) SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID, (SELECT OrderDate FROM customer_order_dates WHERE CustomerID = cod.CustomerID AND first_order = 1) as first_order_date, (SELECT OrderDate FROM customer_order_dates WHERE CustomerID = cod.CustomerID AND last_order = 1) as last_order_date FROM customer_order_dates cod;

query: 计算每个商品最近7次交易的平均销售额
sql: WITH product_transactions AS (SELECT ProductID, OrderDate, Quantity * UnitPrice as amount FROM "Order Details" oi JOIN Orders o ON oi.OrderID = o.OrderID) SELECT ProductID, OrderDate, amount, AVG(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ProductID ORDER BY OrderDate ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as moving_avg_7 FROM product_transactions;

query: 将客户按消费金额分为5个等级
sql: WITH customer_spending AS (SELECT o.CustomerID, SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice) as total_spent FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" oi ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID GROUP BY o.CustomerID) SELECT CustomerID, total_spent, NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_spent DESC) as spending_tier FROM customer_spending;

query: 查询每个国家每月的销售额及当月在该国的排名
sql: WITH country_monthly_sales AS (SELECT o.ShipCountry, STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.OrderDate) as month, SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice) as sales FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" oi ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID GROUP BY o.ShipCountry, month) SELECT ShipCountry, month, sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ShipCountry ORDER BY sales DESC) as monthly_rank_in_country FROM country_monthly_sales;

query: 查询每个商品的下一次被购买的时间
sql: WITH product_purchase_dates AS (SELECT DISTINCT ProductID, OrderDate FROM "Order Details" oi JOIN Orders o ON oi.OrderID = o.OrderID) SELECT ProductID, OrderDate, LEAD(OrderDate) OVER (PARTITION BY ProductID ORDER BY OrderDate) as next_purchase_date FROM product_purchase_dates;

query: 使用CTE查询高价值客户及其订单详情
sql: WITH high_value_customers AS (SELECT o.CustomerID, SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice) as total_spent FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" oi ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID GROUP BY o.CustomerID HAVING total_spent > 10000) SELECT o.OrderID, o.CustomerID, o.OrderDate, hvc.total_spent FROM Orders o JOIN high_value_customers hvc ON o.CustomerID = hvc.CustomerID ORDER BY hvc.total_spent DESC;

query: 使用多层CTE分析客户购买频次和金额
sql: WITH customer_metrics AS (SELECT o.CustomerID, COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderID) as order_count, SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice) as total_spent FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" oi ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID GROUP BY o.CustomerID), customer_segments AS (SELECT CustomerID, order_count, total_spent, CASE WHEN order_count >= 10 AND total_spent > 5000 THEN '高频高额' WHEN order_count >= 10 THEN '高频低额' WHEN total_spent > 5000 THEN '低频高额' ELSE '低频低额' END as segment FROM customer_metrics) SELECT segment, COUNT(*) as customer_count, AVG(order_count) as avg_orders, AVG(total_spent) as avg_spent FROM customer_segments GROUP BY segment;

query: 查询每个国家的新客户占比
sql: WITH first_orders AS (SELECT CustomerID, MIN(OrderDate) as first_order_date FROM Orders GROUP BY CustomerID), monthly_new_customers AS (SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', first_order_date) as month, COUNT(*) as new_customers FROM first_orders GROUP BY month), monthly_all_customers AS (SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', OrderDate) as month, COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) as all_customers FROM Orders GROUP BY month) SELECT mnc.month, mnc.new_customers, mac.all_customers, ROUND(mnc.new_customers * 100.0 / mac.all_customers, 2) as new_customer_rate FROM monthly_new_customers mnc JOIN monthly_all_customers mac ON mnc.month = mac.month;

query: 使用CTE计算客户流失率
sql: WITH customer_last_order AS (SELECT CustomerID, MAX(OrderDate) as last_order_date FROM Orders GROUP BY CustomerID), active_customers AS (SELECT CustomerID FROM customer_last_order WHERE JULIANDAY('2011-12-31') - JULIANDAY(last_order_date) <= 90), churned_customers AS (SELECT CustomerID FROM customer_last_order WHERE JULIANDAY('2011-12-31') - JULIANDAY(last_order_date) > 90) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM churned_customers) as churned_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_last_order) as total_count, ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM churned_customers) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_last_order), 2) as churn_rate;

query: 使用CTE分析商品关联购买
sql: WITH product_pairs AS (SELECT oi1.ProductID as product_a, oi2.ProductID as product_b, COUNT(DISTINCT oi1.OrderID) as co_purchase_count FROM "Order Details" oi1 JOIN "Order Details" oi2 ON oi1.OrderID = oi2.OrderID AND oi1.ProductID < oi2.ProductID GROUP BY oi1.ProductID, oi2.ProductID) SELECT product_a, product_b, co_purchase_count FROM product_pairs WHERE co_purchase_count >= 5 ORDER BY co_purchase_count DESC LIMIT 20;

query: 查询购买了相同商品的不同客户

query: 查询同一客户在不同订单中购买的商品对
sql: SELECT o1.CustomerID, oi1.ProductID as product1, oi2.ProductID as product2, COUNT(*) as pair_count FROM Orders o1 JOIN "Order Details" oi1 ON o1.OrderID = oi1.OrderID JOIN Orders o2 ON o1.CustomerID = o2.CustomerID AND o1.OrderID < o2.OrderID JOIN "Order Details" oi2 ON o2.OrderID = oi2.OrderID WHERE oi1.ProductID < oi2.ProductID GROUP BY o1.CustomerID, oi1.ProductID, oi2.ProductID HAVING pair_count >= 2;

query: 生成每个国家按月的销售额透视表

query: 按时间段统计每个国家的订单分布
sql: SELECT ShipCountry, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%H', OrderDate) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 0 AND 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as morning, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%H', OrderDate) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 8 AND 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as afternoon, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%H', OrderDate) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 16 AND 23 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as evening FROM Orders GROUP BY ShipCountry;

query: 查询购买过所有畅销商品的客户
sql: SELECT DISTINCT o.CustomerID FROM Orders o WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT ProductID FROM (SELECT ProductID FROM "Order Details" GROUP BY ProductID ORDER BY SUM(Quantity) DESC LIMIT 10) top_products WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Order Details" oi2 JOIN Orders o2 ON oi2.OrderID = o2.OrderID WHERE o2.CustomerID = o.CustomerID AND oi2.ProductID = top_products.ProductID));

query: 查询从未购买过高价商品的客户

query: 查询销售额超过所属国家平均水平的订单
sql: WITH order_amounts AS (SELECT o.OrderID, o.ShipCountry, SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice) as amount FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" oi ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID GROUP BY o.OrderID, o.ShipCountry), country_avg AS (SELECT ShipCountry, AVG(amount) as avg_amount FROM order_amounts GROUP BY ShipCountry) SELECT oa.OrderID, oa.ShipCountry, oa.amount FROM order_amounts oa JOIN country_avg ca ON oa.ShipCountry = ca.ShipCountry WHERE oa.amount > ca.avg_amount;

query: 查询既购买过商品A又购买过商品B的客户
sql: SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" oi ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID WHERE oi.ProductID = '85123A' INTERSECT SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" oi ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID WHERE oi.ProductID = '71053';

query: 查询只在英国有订单但在其他国家没有订单的客户
sql: SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID FROM Orders WHERE ShipCountry = 'United Kingdom' EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID FROM Orders WHERE ShipCountry != 'United Kingdom';

query: 合并2010年10月和11月的订单统计
sql: SELECT '2010-10' as month, COUNT(*) as order_count, SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice) as total_sales FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" oi ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.OrderDate) = '2010-10' UNION ALL SELECT '2010-11' as month, COUNT(*) as order_count, SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice) as total_sales FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" oi ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.OrderDate) = '2010-11';

query: 计算每个客户的RFM指标
sql: WITH customer_rfm AS (SELECT o.CustomerID, JULIANDAY('2011-12-31') - JULIANDAY(MAX(o.OrderDate)) as recency, COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderID) as frequency, SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice) as monetary FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" oi ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID GROUP BY o.CustomerID) SELECT CustomerID, recency, frequency, monetary, CASE WHEN recency <= 30 THEN 5 WHEN recency <= 60 THEN 4 WHEN recency <= 90 THEN 3 WHEN recency <= 180 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END as r_score, CASE WHEN frequency >= 20 THEN 5 WHEN frequency >= 10 THEN 4 WHEN frequency >= 5 THEN 3 WHEN frequency >= 2 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END as f_score, CASE WHEN monetary >= 5000 THEN 5 WHEN monetary >= 2000 THEN 4 WHEN monetary >= 1000 THEN 3 WHEN monetary >= 500 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END as m_score FROM customer_rfm;

query: 计算月度客户留存率
sql: WITH first_purchase AS (SELECT CustomerID, STRFTIME('%Y-%m', MIN(OrderDate)) as cohort_month FROM Orders GROUP BY CustomerID), monthly_activity AS (SELECT CustomerID, STRFTIME('%Y-%m', OrderDate) as activity_month FROM Orders GROUP BY CustomerID, activity_month) SELECT fp.cohort_month, COUNT(DISTINCT fp.CustomerID) as cohort_size, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ma.activity_month = fp.cohort_month THEN fp.CustomerID END) as month_0, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN CAST((JULIANDAY(ma.activity_month || '-01') - JULIANDAY(fp.cohort_month || '-01')) / 30 AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN fp.CustomerID END) as month_1, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN CAST((JULIANDAY(ma.activity_month || '-01') - JULIANDAY(fp.cohort_month || '-01')) / 30 AS INTEGER) = 2 THEN fp.CustomerID END) as month_2 FROM first_purchase fp LEFT JOIN monthly_activity ma ON fp.CustomerID = ma.CustomerID GROUP BY fp.cohort_month;

query: 计算每周订单量的周环比增长
sql: WITH weekly_orders AS (SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-W%W', OrderDate) as week, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM Orders GROUP BY week) SELECT week, order_count, LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY week) as prev_week, ROUND((order_count - LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY week)) * 100.0 / LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY week), 2) as week_over_week_growth FROM weekly_orders;

query: 计算每个商品的7天移动平均销量
sql: WITH daily_product_sales AS (SELECT ProductID, STRFTIME('%Y-%m-%d', o.OrderDate) as sale_date, SUM(oi.Quantity) as daily_quantity FROM "Order Details" oi JOIN Orders o ON oi.OrderID = o.OrderID GROUP BY ProductID, sale_date) SELECT ProductID, sale_date, daily_quantity, AVG(daily_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY ProductID ORDER BY sale_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as ma_7_days FROM daily_product_sales;

query: 计算每个客户的复购率
sql: WITH customer_orders AS (SELECT CustomerID, COUNT(DISTINCT OrderID) as total_orders FROM Orders GROUP BY CustomerID) SELECT CASE WHEN total_orders = 1 THEN '一次性客户' WHEN total_orders BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN '低频复购' WHEN total_orders BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '中频复购' ELSE '高频复购' END as customer_type, COUNT(*) as customer_count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_orders), 2) as percentage FROM customer_orders GROUP BY customer_type;

query: 查找频繁一起购买的商品组合（支持度>5%）
sql: WITH total_orders AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT OrderID) as total FROM "Order Details"), product_pairs AS (SELECT oi1.ProductID as product_a, oi2.ProductID as product_b, COUNT(DISTINCT oi1.OrderID) as pair_count FROM "Order Details" oi1 JOIN "Order Details" oi2 ON oi1.OrderID = oi2.OrderID AND oi1.ProductID < oi2.ProductID GROUP BY oi1.ProductID, oi2.ProductID) SELECT product_a, product_b, pair_count, ROUND(pair_count * 100.0 / (SELECT total FROM total_orders), 2) as support FROM product_pairs WHERE pair_count * 100.0 / (SELECT total FROM total_orders) > 5 ORDER BY support DESC;

query: 基于消费行为的客户细分
sql: WITH customer_behavior AS (SELECT o.CustomerID, COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderID) as order_count, SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice) as total_spent, AVG(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice) as avg_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.ProductID) as product_variety, JULIANDAY('2011-12-31') - JULIANDAY(MAX(o.OrderDate)) as days_since_last_order FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" oi ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID GROUP BY o.CustomerID) SELECT CASE WHEN days_since_last_order <= 30 AND total_spent > 5000 THEN 'VIP活跃客户' WHEN days_since_last_order <= 30 THEN '普通活跃客户' WHEN days_since_last_order <= 90 AND total_spent > 5000 THEN 'VIP沉睡客户' WHEN days_since_last_order <= 90 THEN '普通沉睡客户' ELSE '流失客户' END as segment, COUNT(*) as customer_count, AVG(total_spent) as avg_spent, AVG(order_count) as avg_orders FROM customer_behavior GROUP BY segment;

query: 检测异常高额订单（超过3倍标准差）
sql: WITH order_stats AS (SELECT AVG(order_total) as avg_total, (AVG(order_total * order_total) - AVG(order_total) * AVG(order_total)) as variance FROM (SELECT OrderID, SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) as order_total FROM "Order Details" GROUP BY OrderID)), order_amounts AS (SELECT OrderID, SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) as total FROM "Order Details" GROUP BY OrderID) SELECT oa.OrderID, oa.total, os.avg_total, SQRT(os.variance) as std_dev FROM order_amounts oa, order_stats os WHERE oa.total > os.avg_total + 3 * SQRT(os.variance);

query: 分析商品的生命周期阶段
sql: WITH product_monthly_sales AS (SELECT ProductID, STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.OrderDate) as month, SUM(oi.Quantity) as monthly_sales FROM "Order Details" oi JOIN Orders o ON oi.OrderID = o.OrderID GROUP BY ProductID, month), product_trends AS (SELECT ProductID, month, monthly_sales, LAG(monthly_sales, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ProductID ORDER BY month) as prev_month_1, LAG(monthly_sales, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY ProductID ORDER BY month) as prev_month_2 FROM product_monthly_sales) SELECT ProductID, month, monthly_sales, CASE WHEN prev_month_1 IS NULL OR prev_month_2 IS NULL THEN '导入期' WHEN monthly_sales > prev_month_1 AND prev_month_1 > prev_month_2 THEN '成长期' WHEN monthly_sales >= prev_month_1 * 0.9 AND monthly_sales <= prev_month_1 * 1.1 THEN '成熟期' ELSE '衰退期' END as lifecycle_stage FROM product_trends WHERE prev_month_1 IS NOT NULL AND prev_month_2 IS NOT NULL;

query: 计算累计收入占比（帕累托分析）
sql: WITH product_revenue AS (SELECT ProductID, SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) as revenue FROM "Order Details" GROUP BY ProductID), ranked_products AS (SELECT ProductID, revenue, SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC) as cumulative_revenue, SUM(revenue) OVER () as total_revenue FROM product_revenue) SELECT ProductID, revenue, ROUND(revenue * 100.0 / total_revenue, 2) as revenue_percentage, ROUND(cumulative_revenue * 100.0 / total_revenue, 2) as cumulative_percentage FROM ranked_products ORDER BY revenue DESC;

query: 预测客户生命周期价值（CLV）
sql: WITH customer_metrics AS (SELECT o.CustomerID, COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderID) as purchase_count, SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice) as total_revenue, (JULIANDAY(MAX(o.OrderDate)) - JULIANDAY(MIN(o.OrderDate))) / 365.0 as customer_lifespan_years, SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderID) as avg_order_value FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" oi ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID GROUP BY o.CustomerID HAVING customer_lifespan_years > 0) SELECT CustomerID, purchase_count, total_revenue, ROUND(customer_lifespan_years, 2) as lifespan_years, ROUND(avg_order_value, 2) as avg_order_value, ROUND(purchase_count / customer_lifespan_years, 2) as purchase_frequency_per_year, ROUND((purchase_count / customer_lifespan_years) * avg_order_value * 3, 2) as predicted_clv_3years FROM customer_metrics WHERE purchase_count >= 2;

query: 计算商品关联规则的置信度
sql: WITH product_counts AS (SELECT ProductID, COUNT(DISTINCT OrderID) as product_count FROM "Order Details" GROUP BY ProductID), pair_counts AS (SELECT oi1.ProductID as product_a, oi2.ProductID as product_b, COUNT(DISTINCT oi1.OrderID) as pair_count FROM "Order Details" oi1 JOIN "Order Details" oi2 ON oi1.OrderID = oi2.OrderID AND oi1.ProductID < oi2.ProductID GROUP BY oi1.ProductID, oi2.ProductID) SELECT pc.product_a, pc.product_b, pc.pair_count, pa.product_count as count_a, pb.product_count as count_b, ROUND(pc.pair_count * 100.0 / pa.product_count, 2) as confidence_a_to_b, ROUND(pc.pair_count * 100.0 / pb.product_count, 2) as confidence_b_to_a FROM pair_counts pc JOIN product_counts pa ON pc.product_a = pa.ProductID JOIN product_counts pb ON pc.product_b = pb.ProductID WHERE pc.pair_count >= 10 ORDER BY confidence_a_to_b DESC LIMIT 20;

query: 分析每个月的季节性销售模式
sql: WITH monthly_sales AS (SELECT CAST(STRFTIME('%m', o.OrderDate) AS INTEGER) as month, SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice) as sales FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" oi ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID GROUP BY month), avg_monthly_sales AS (SELECT AVG(sales) as avg_sales FROM monthly_sales) SELECT ms.month, ms.sales, ams.avg_sales, ROUND((ms.sales - ams.avg_sales) * 100.0 / ams.avg_sales, 2) as deviation_percentage, CASE WHEN ms.sales > ams.avg_sales * 1.2 THEN '旺季' WHEN ms.sales < ams.avg_sales * 0.8 THEN '淡季' ELSE '平季' END as season_type FROM monthly_sales ms, avg_monthly_sales ams ORDER BY ms.month;

query: 分析不同国家的客户价值分布
sql: WITH customer_value AS (SELECT o.CustomerID, o.ShipCountry, SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice) as total_spent FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" oi ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID GROUP BY o.CustomerID, o.ShipCountry), country_stats AS (SELECT ShipCountry, COUNT(*) as customer_count, AVG(total_spent) as avg_customer_value, MIN(total_spent) as min_value, MAX(total_spent) as max_value, SUM(total_spent) as total_revenue FROM customer_value GROUP BY ShipCountry) SELECT ShipCountry, customer_count, ROUND(avg_customer_value, 2) as avg_value, ROUND(min_value, 2) as min_value, ROUND(max_value, 2) as max_value, ROUND(total_revenue, 2) as total_revenue, ROUND(total_revenue / (SELECT SUM(total_revenue) FROM country_stats) * 100, 2) as revenue_share FROM country_stats ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

query: 分析价格弹性（不同价格段的销量）
sql: WITH price_bands AS (SELECT CASE WHEN UnitPrice < 1 THEN '0-1' WHEN UnitPrice < 5 THEN '1-5' WHEN UnitPrice < 10 THEN '5-10' WHEN UnitPrice < 20 THEN '10-20' ELSE '20+' END as price_range, ProductID, AVG(UnitPrice) as avg_price, SUM(Quantity) as total_quantity FROM "Order Details" GROUP BY price_range, ProductID) SELECT price_range, COUNT(DISTINCT ProductID) as product_count, ROUND(AVG(avg_price), 2) as avg_price_in_range, SUM(total_quantity) as total_sales_volume, ROUND(SUM(total_quantity) / COUNT(DISTINCT ProductID), 2) as avg_sales_per_product FROM price_bands GROUP BY price_range ORDER BY avg_price_in_range;

query: 识别交叉销售机会（买了A未买B的客户）
sql: WITH product_a_buyers AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.CustomerID FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" oi ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID WHERE oi.ProductID = '85123A'), product_b_buyers AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.CustomerID FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" oi ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID WHERE oi.ProductID = '71053'), cross_sell_opportunity AS (SELECT CustomerID FROM product_a_buyers WHERE CustomerID NOT IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM product_b_buyers)) SELECT COUNT(*) as opportunity_count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_a_buyers), 2) as penetration_rate FROM cross_sell_opportunity;

query: 计算商品库存周转率
sql: WITH product_sales AS (SELECT ProductID, COUNT(DISTINCT STRFTIME('%Y-%m-%d', o.OrderDate)) as sales_days, SUM(oi.Quantity) as total_sold FROM "Order Details" oi JOIN Orders o ON oi.OrderID = o.OrderID GROUP BY ProductID) SELECT ProductID, total_sold, sales_days, ROUND(total_sold * 1.0 / sales_days, 2) as daily_sales_rate, CASE WHEN total_sold * 1.0 / sales_days > 10 THEN '快速周转' WHEN total_sold * 1.0 / sales_days > 5 THEN '正常周转' ELSE '滞销' END as turnover_status FROM product_sales WHERE sales_days > 0 ORDER BY daily_sales_rate DESC;

query: 分析新客户获客渠道效果（按国家）
sql: WITH first_orders AS (SELECT CustomerID, ShipCountry, MIN(OrderDate) as first_order_date FROM Orders GROUP BY CustomerID), monthly_new_customers AS (SELECT ShipCountry, STRFTIME('%Y-%m', first_order_date) as acquisition_month, COUNT(*) as new_customers FROM first_orders GROUP BY ShipCountry, acquisition_month) SELECT ShipCountry, acquisition_month, new_customers, SUM(new_customers) OVER (PARTITION BY ShipCountry ORDER BY acquisition_month) as cumulative_customers FROM monthly_new_customers ORDER BY ShipCountry, acquisition_month;

query: 基于历史趋势预测下月收入
sql: WITH monthly_revenue AS (SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.OrderDate) as month, SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice) as revenue FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" oi ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID GROUP BY month), revenue_growth AS (SELECT month, revenue, LAG(revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month) as prev_month_revenue, LAG(revenue, 2) OVER (ORDER BY month) as prev_2month_revenue, LAG(revenue, 3) OVER (ORDER BY month) as prev_3month_revenue FROM monthly_revenue) SELECT month, revenue, ROUND((revenue + prev_month_revenue + prev_2month_revenue) / 3, 2) as ma_3months, ROUND((revenue - prev_month_revenue) * 100.0 / prev_month_revenue, 2) as mom_growth, ROUND(revenue * (1 + (revenue - prev_month_revenue) / prev_month_revenue), 2) as next_month_forecast FROM revenue_growth WHERE prev_3month_revenue IS NOT NULL ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 1;

query: 综合分析：高价值客户的购买模式
sql: WITH high_value_customers AS (SELECT o.CustomerID, SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice) as total_spent FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" oi ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID GROUP BY o.CustomerID ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 100), customer_patterns AS (SELECT hvc.CustomerID, o.ShipCountry, COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderID) as order_frequency, AVG(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice) as avg_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.ProductID) as product_variety, STRFTIME('%w', o.OrderDate) as day_of_week, CAST(STRFTIME('%H', o.OrderDate) AS INTEGER) as hour_of_day FROM high_value_customers hvc JOIN Orders o ON hvc.CustomerID = o.CustomerID JOIN "Order Details" oi ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID GROUP BY hvc.CustomerID, o.ShipCountry, day_of_week, hour_of_day) SELECT ShipCountry, ROUND(AVG(order_frequency), 2) as avg_orders, ROUND(AVG(avg_order_value), 2) as avg_basket_size, ROUND(AVG(product_variety), 2) as avg_product_variety, day_of_week, hour_of_day, COUNT(*) as pattern_frequency FROM customer_patterns GROUP BY ShipCountry, day_of_week, hour_of_day HAVING pattern_frequency > 5 ORDER BY ShipCountry, pattern_frequency DESC;
